dimensions.title: Cognitive
activities: Use flashcards for shapes and colors
watchFor: Struggles with understanding simple instructions
Shows little interest in problem-solving activities
Doesn't recognize familiar colors or shapes

dimensions.title: Language
milestones: Can name most objects in a picture book
watchFor: Limited vocabulary for their age
Struggles to express needs or feelings
Doesn't respond to questions or directions

dimensions.title: Physical
milestones: Learn to hop on one foot
activities: Provide crayons and playdough for fine motor skills
watchFor: Difficulty with physical activities typical for their age
Avoids running or playing with peers
Shows reluctance to use utensils during meals

dimensions.title: Social
milestones: Engages in parallel play with peers
Shows a range of emotions towards others
activities: Encourage role-playing with dolls or action figures
watchFor: Exhibits aggressive behaviors towards others
Struggles to play with other children
Shows little interest in making friends

dimensions.title: Emotional
milestones: Begins to show empathy (e.g., comforting a crying friend)
watchFor: Frequent mood swings or emotional outbursts
Lack of interest in social interactions
Difficulty calming down after strong emotions

dimensions.title: Curiosity
milestones: Shows interest in nature and animals
activities: Visit a zoo or nature center
watchFor: Displays little interest in asking questions
Avoids exploring new places
Seem less engaged with hands-on activities

dimensions.title: Learning
milestones: Can focus on an activity for a few minutes
activities: Have short reading sessions with interactive books
Practice sorting objects by size or color
watchFor: Inability to remain focused on tasks
Shows disinterest in learning games
Struggles to follow simple routines

dimensions.title: Independence
milestones: Can dress and undress with assistance
Begins to handle some self-care tasks
activities: Assign simple chores like putting away toys
Teach basic hygiene practices like washing hands
watchFor: Reluctance to try self-care tasks
Avoids following simple routines
Struggles significantly with independence tasks compared to peers
